eyebrow: Two ways to pay for the same VM
code:
Pay-as-you-go:     billed by the hour, no commitment
Reserved instance: commit 1-3 years, save ~40-60%

Dev/test VM (off most nights) -> pay-as-you-go
Production DB (24/7, 2+ years) -> reserved instance
caption: Neither is "correct" — it's a bet on how predictable your usage is.
Visibility, accountability, optimization — the three principles the tool is built around.

Alert:   fires at 50%, 90%, 100% of that threshold

Catches a runaway VM on day 2 -- not on the invoice, day 30.
caption: The difference between reacting to an invoice and catching it early.
